rows.note: Use 正 as the casual all-purpose choice for something very good, enjoyable, or excellent.

example.english: The pineapple buns at this cha chaan teng are truly wonderful.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲菠蘿包真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 bo1 lo4 baau1 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use 犀利 for something impressive or exceptionally good, especially an achievement, skill, or result.

example.english: You did a wonderful job on the report this time.
example.traditional: 你今次份報告做得真係犀利。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 zan1 hai6 sai1 lei6

rows.note: Use 神奇 when the thing is extraordinary or almost magical rather than merely very good.

example.english: This magic trick is truly wonderful.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mo1 seot6 zan1 hai6 san4 kei4

rows.note: Use 驚人 when the main point is that something is astonishing or remarkably unusual.

example.english: They ran fifty kilometres in one day—their performance is wonderful.
example.traditional: 佢一日跑完五十公里，成績真係驚人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jat6 paau2 jyun4 ng5 sap6 gung1 lei5 sing4 zik1 zan1 hai6 ging1 jan4
